desc.en: One-stop solution with open-source SDK for mobile in-app subscription integration to iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Unity, or web app. Free up to $10k monthly revenue.
desc.zh: 提供开源 SDK 的一站式解决方案，用于将移动应用内订阅集成到 iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Unity 或 Web 应用。月收入不超过 $10k 免费。

desc.en: Real-time mid-market exchange rates for 150+ currencies with official JavaScript, Python, and PHP SDKs. Free tier includes 300 requests/month over HTTPS.
desc.zh: 提供 150+ 种货币的实时中间市场汇率，附带官方 JavaScript、Python 和 PHP SDK。免费套餐包含每月 300 次 HTTPS 请求。

desc.en: Cancel flows (open-sourced), churn metrics, and revenue analytics for subscription businesses. Free forever.
desc.zh: 面向订阅业务的取消流程（开源）、流失指标和收入分析。永久免费。

desc.en: Free currency conversion and exchange rate data API. Free 300 requests per month, 10 requests per minute for private use.
desc.zh: 免费的货币转换和汇率数据 API。每月免费 300 次请求，私人用途每分钟 10 次请求。

desc.en: Live Currency Rates for Physical and Cryptocurrencies, delivered in JSON and XML. The free tier offers 1,250 API requests/month.
desc.zh: 以 JSON 和 XML 提供法币和加密货币的实时汇率。免费套餐每月提供 1,250 次 API 请求。

desc.en: Provides current and historical currency exchange rates. Free DEVELOPER plan available with 1000 requests/month.
desc.zh: 提供当前和历史货币汇率。提供免费 DEVELOPER 套餐，每月 1000 次请求。

desc.en: Reliable Exchange Rates and Currency Conversion for your Business, 100 API requests/month free.
desc.zh: 为你的业务提供可靠的汇率和货币转换，每月 100 次 API 请求免费。

desc.en: An easy-to-use currency conversion JSON API. The free tier updates once per day with a limit of 1,500 requests/month.
desc.zh: 易用的货币转换 JSON API。免费套餐每天更新一次，每月限制 1,500 次请求。

desc.en: Real-time currency rates for 160+ currencies with 60-second updates and official SDKs. Free tier includes 300 requests/month.
desc.zh: 160+ 种货币的实时汇率，60 秒更新，提供官方 SDK。免费套餐包含每月 300 次请求。

desc.en: Help merchants to prevent payment fraud and chargebacks. Free Micro Plan available with 500 queries/month.
desc.zh: 帮助商家防范支付欺诈和拒付。提供免费 Micro 套餐，每月 500 次查询。

desc.en: Provides real-time and historical exchange rates. The free tier requires attribution.
desc.zh: 提供实时和历史汇率。免费套餐要求注明出处。

desc.en: Generate revenue from APIs via usage-based billing. Connect to Stripe, Chargebee, etc. The free tier offers 30,000 events/month.
desc.zh: 通过基于用量的计费从 API 获取收入。可连接 Stripe、Chargebee 等。免费套餐每月提供 30,000 个事件。

desc.en: Automatically adjust pricing based on visitor location to expand your business globally and reach new markets (purchasing power parity). The free plan includes 7,500 API requests/month.
desc.zh: 根据访客位置自动调整定价，助你向全球扩展业务并开拓新市场（购买力平价）。免费套餐包含每月 7,500 次 API 请求。

desc.en: All-in-one cross-platform subscription management platform offering analytics, A/B testing, Apple Search Ads, remote configs, and growth tools for optimizing in-app purchases and monetization. Compatible with iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Unity, Cordova, Stripe, and web. Free up to $10k in monthly tracked revenue.
desc.zh: 全能型跨平台订阅管理平台，提供分析、A/B 测试、Apple Search Ads、远程配置和增长工具，用于优化应用内购买和变现。兼容 iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Unity、Cordova、Stripe 和 Web。每月被跟踪收入不超过 $10k 免费。

desc.en: Hosted backend for in-app purchases and subscriptions (iOS and Android). Free up to $2.5k/mo in tracked revenue.
desc.zh: 用于应用内购买和订阅的托管后端（iOS 和 Android）。每月被跟踪收入不超过 $2.5k 免费。

desc.en: Instant VAT number validation and EU VAT rates API, free 100 API requests/month
desc.zh: 即时 VAT 号码验证和欧盟 VAT 税率 API，每月 100 次 API 请求免费
